newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kai Peng to have Maju as key shareholder.
newsitem.headline: Kai Peng to have Maju as key shareholder.

text.p: Kai Peng Bhd said on Monday it has proposed to buy a steel products manufacturer and a steel structure fabricator for 141.46 million ringgit.

The proposals will see Maju Holdings Sdn Bhd and Khairuddin Abdul Rahman -- the vendors of the two companies eyed by Kai Peng -- emerging as the largest shareholders in the engineering firm, it said in a statement.
Kai Peng said it was proposing to buy a 59.41 percent stake in Maju Steel Sdn Bhd for 94.13 million ringgit by issuing 10.46 million new Kai Peng shares at 9.0 ringgit each.
The new shares will be issued to the vendor of the Maju Steel shares, Maju Holdings.

Kai Peng said it also plans to buy the entire issued and paid-up capital of Maju Egatt (M) Sdn Bhd for 47.33 million ringgit to be paid by the issue of 5.26 million new Kai Peng shares at 9.0 ringgit apiece.
These new Kai Peng shares will be issued to the two vendors of Maju Egatt, Maju Holdings and Khairuddin.
After the proposed acquisitions, Kai Peng's issued and paid-up capital will increase to 34.72 million from 19 million shares.
The deals will see Maju Holdings and Khairuddin holding a total of 15.72 million shares in Kai Peng, representing 45.28 percent of the enlarged and paid-up capital of the company.
Kai Peng said the proposed acquisitions will directly complement the engineering business of the group.
